llm_guidance.title_invalid_json: What Does This Mean? (Broken JSON Response)
llm_guidance.title_request_failed: What Does This Mean? (HTTP / Connection Failure)
llm_guidance.body_invalid_json:
Your AI model replied, but its response was formatted incorrectly (broken JSON) and could not be read.

• Why this happens: M.A.R.A.S requires the AI to reply in a strict structured data format. Even good models occasionally make a formatting mistake, and clicking Retry usually fixes it.
• Seeing this error too often? If this happens frequently, the AI model assigned to your '{slot}' slot in SkyrimNet is incapable of returning valid JSON reliably most of the time. Consider switching that slot in SkyrimNet to a more capable model.
llm_guidance.body_request_failed:
SkyrimNet could not get a response from your AI provider for the '{slot}' model slot (HTTP / network error or empty reply).

• Cloud AI (OpenRouter, OpenAI, etc.): The service may have timed out, hit a rate limit, run out of API credits, or your API key / model name in SkyrimNet may be invalid.
• Local AI (Ollama, KoboldCPP, LM Studio): Your local AI server may be offline, still loading a model, or overloaded.
• What to do: Click Retry to send the request again. If it keeps failing, check your internet connection or SkyrimNet provider settings.
llm_guidance.body_mixed_batch:
Some AI requests failed to connect, while others returned unreadable data:

• HTTP / Connection Failed: SkyrimNet could not reach your AI provider or received an empty reply (timeout, rate limit, out of API credits, invalid API key, or local AI server offline).
• Broken JSON Response: The AI model in your SkyrimNet '{slot}' slot replied with broken formatting. If you see broken JSON errors too often, your '{slot}' model is incapable of returning valid JSON reliably and should be changed to a stronger model.

Diagnostic report saved to:
{path}

• Step 1: DO NOT save your game. Click 'Quit to Desktop' below.
• Step 2: Reinstall the previous version of M.A.R.A.S you used on this save.
• Step 3: Send MARAS_MigrationReport.log (and MARAS.log) to the mod author and wait for help.
